name: dundor-ledger
description: Read Dundor combat logs and reconstruct what actually happened in a fight.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dundor/parser && npm run build -w @dundor/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dundor/parser && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run publish:cf -w @dundor/web
